label: Verifier's dataset
description: Keeps verify.db, a row per test for its first sighting and every red/green flip, stamped with the commit, the dirty tree and the UTC time of that change (goal/G8.1). Started by the node; reached by jobs.api on the loopback door. Runs are not stored at all.

args.name: db
args.description: The database file. Empty: verify.db beside this server, which git ignores. Every suite hands a temp path, so a test never touches the measurements of a real run.
